one_line: An open-loop question linking the product to the sea, answered by a sunny, real activity and a warm ending.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a hand holds two Giotto watercolour palettes in a tiled room. Said (transcript): "מה הקשר בין צבעי ימיים של ג'יוטו לבין הים?", then "רוצים לדעת? תישארו איתי". Subtitle builds from 0:00, "לבין הים?" at 0:03 over the sea.
q1_hook.why: A question that joins the product to an unexpected place, plus "stay with me", opens a gap the beach footage answers by 0:08 (H5). The brand is in hand at 0:00 (S1, H3), and the line is said and subtitled together (H6, T3). A voice but no face (H4).

beats.what: Hand holds two Giotto palettes in a tiled room; the question subtitled
beats.why: Product and question in one frame.

beats.what: Cut to the sea, children at a puddle, a palette held on the beach; "רוצים לדעת? תישארו איתי"
beats.why: Names the loop out loud, then starts answering.

beats.what: Top-down children paint shells; brush close-ups; labels "שחרור שליטה", "הסרה ותיקון"; brush in sea water
beats.why: The activity shown step by step.

beats.what: Wide shot of children kneeling at a puddle, then a top-down group; faces pixelated at 0:22 to 0:25
Purple paint on a shell, rows of painted shells, a child's palm of shells
beats.why: The visible result, bright and varied.

beats.what: A girl throws shells into the sea, waves; "הצדפים מתנקים בקלות במים"; the spoken ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Spoken at about 0:41 (transcript): "אהבתם? תעשו גם את הפעילות הזאת ותיהנו כמונו". Mid-Reel "תביאו עוד מכחולים". Caption: "אל תוותרו על הפעילות הזאת!!! תודו לי אחר כך". No question, send or save ask.
q2_flow.why: The spoken open loop is answered within 8 s (H5), and a new place or angle every 2 to 8 s keeps a sunny, real scene moving (R3, F8). The return of the shells to the sea is a warm last image (K1, R4). The 0:20 to 0:37 stretch is a long run of similar painting shots (R1).

q3_cta.what: Spoken at about 0:41 (transcript): "אהבתם? תעשו גם את הפעילות הזאת ותיהנו כמונו", over wet sand with no text. Not on screen. Caption: "אל תוותרו על הפעילות הזאת!!! תודו לי אחר כך" and the brand tag.
q3_cta.why: One idea, try the activity, said and echoed in the caption, a purposeful invitation not bait (C1, C2). But it is heard over bare sand with no text, and nothing gives a keyword, a link or the product name at the end (C6, C3).

q4_shown.what: Two Giotto palettes (blue, purple) in hand at 0:00 and open on the sand; children painting shells; brush close-ups; rows of painted shells; a child's palm of shells; shells thrown into the sea. Skill labels on screen. Faces pixelated 0:22 to 0:25. No price.
q4_shown.why: The palettes are named on screen at 0:00 and used in every later shot (S1, K5), and rows of painted shells are a visible result. The narrator vouches in the first person, "הילדות סופר נהנו" (S6). The wash-off claim is shown only as shells thrown into waves (K4). Pixelated faces show a privacy choice (S5).

q5_edit.what: 7 shots in 45 s, 6.5 s average, straight cuts at 2.6, 8.2, 20.0, 21.6, 26.9 and 37.8 s. Voiceover nearly wall to wall, short keyword subtitles. Ends on wet sand under the spoken ask, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Cuts between very different views (hands, sea, top-down children, close-ups) keep it fresh (R3, F8), though long takes make it calm, not snappy (E2). Voice with keyword labels works with sound on or off (E4, T2). The last 3 s are bare sand, a dead tail (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: Painting shells with watercolours at the beach, then returning them to the sea; a summer activity said to develop skills. Serves a parent looking for a holiday idea.
q6_topic.why: "What do I do with the kids at the beach" is a seasonal parent concern (K6, K7), told with warm images of children in the sun (K1, K8). The skills list is a developmental claim, stated lightly (K4). The product is the means, the activity is the topic (K5).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone in daylight. A hand holding two palettes in a tiled room, wide shots of the sea and children, top-down views of children painting, low close-ups of shells. Faces turned away or pixelated at 0:22 to 0:25.
q7_filmed.why: A real beach, sun and handheld movement look native (H8, F7). Brush and shell close-ups are large enough for a phone (F4), and top-down views show the action (F5). Full 9:16, sharp (F1, F3). Subtitles at about 73 to 85% down are in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Small white subtitle labels, centred at about 73 to 85% down, a few words at a time: "מה הקשר בין צבעי המים של ג'יאוטו" (0:00), "לבין הים?" (0:03), "שחרור שליטה" (0:13), "יחס מים-צבע" (0:14), "הסרה ותיקון" (0:16), "צבעים מיוחדים מרוכזים ובוהקים" (0:27), "הצדפים מתנקים בקלות במים" (0:38). No CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "אל תוותרו על הפעילות הזאת!!! תודו לי אחר כך🤎😘". About 10 words and the tag @giotto_israel. No hashtags, no product or occasion words, no question, no partnership word.
q8_text.why: Short labels follow the voice, so the hook and claims read muted (T1, T2), but they sit in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption is a one-line push with no keywords or hashtags (T7) and a brand tag as the only disclosure (S7, T8).

weak_points: The wash-off claim shown only as thrown shells; the spoken CTA heard over bare sand and never shown; skill labels in small jargon; pixel blocks over faces; a caption with no keywords, disclosing only by tag.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with the product in hand and a question that links it to an unexpected place, then show the real use, with hands only.
not_verified: Who the narrator is and whether the children are hers; whether the partnership was paid (co-author listed, no label, no word); music (none evident); some voiceover words (the transcript is garbled around 0:24 to 0:30). Corrections to the first pass: the hook text is spelled "ג'יאוטו" on screen; the wash-off claim is not shown as paint dissolving; a girl's face is partly visible at 0:26, outside the pixelated stretch. Plays 14,158, likes 177, comments 24 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
